content: "Ensure that the LED cable is removed from the CORE-One-bed-cable-cover-bottom before proceeding." This and the image together are *exceedingly* unclear as to what I'm actually supposed to do. I'm assuming "CORE-One-bed-cable-cover-bottom" is the name of one of the printed parts here, but having purchased my CORE One preassembled it has close to zero meaning to me.

replies.content: Wiggle the wires that are under the red+black heatbed power cables out of the channel of the bottom piece of the cover as show in the picture.

content:
The third photo is very misleading, it shows the LED cable **on** the heatbed together with the power leads and the thermistor cable pulled aside along the back, whereas it should be the other way around.

I.e. the thin two-wire bundle should be on the heatbed together with the power leads.

replies.content: This is how mine was?  That is I had to pull the LED cable from beside the power cable as directed and then it looked just like the last image.
